privacy.s1.b: When you browse SmarTok Store as a guest, we store your shopping cart locally in your browser (localStorage) so your selections persist between visits. When you sign in, we receive your name, email address, and profile photo from Google Sign-In — the only authentication method we support. We never see or store your Google password.
privacy.s2.b: Persistent cart & favorites: your cart contents and wishlist are stored against your account (in our Firebase-backed user document) so they sync across sessions and devices. Order fulfillment: checkout is processed by Stripe, and products are manufactured and shipped by our print-on-demand partner; we share only the information required to produce and deliver your order. Account identification: your Google email and profile photo identify your account in the navbar.
privacy.s3.b: We use browser localStorage — not advertising cookies — for the guest cart and cached favorites. Authentication session data is managed by Firebase/Google on our behalf. Clearing your browser storage removes locally stored data immediately.
privacy.s4.b: Google / Firebase: authentication and account data storage. Stripe: payment processing — card details never touch our servers. Printify: product catalog, manufacturing, and fulfillment.
privacy.s5.b: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time. The fastest way to delete everything — profile, cart, and favorites — is the Delete Account option in your profile menu, which removes your data immediately. You may also contact us at hello@smartok.app. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.s6.b: Account data is retained while your account exists. Deleting your account removes your profile, cart, and favorites from our database. Order records may be retained as required for tax, accounting, and legal purposes.
privacy.s7.b: Questions about this policy: hello@smartok.app or visit support.smartok.app.
terms.s1.b: By accessing or purchasing from SmarTok Store, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the store.
terms.s2.b: Accounts are created exclusively through Google Sign-In. You are responsible for activity under your account. Your cart and favorites are stored against your account and synced across devices. You may delete your account — and all associated store data — at any time from your profile menu.
terms.s3.b: Products are made to order through our print-on-demand partner. We strive for accurate product images and descriptions, but colors and mockups may vary slightly from the final product. Prices are shown at checkout before payment and may change without notice.
terms.s4.b: All payments are processed securely by Stripe. We do not store card numbers or payment credentials. By completing a purchase you authorize us to charge the payment method provided.
terms.s5.b: Orders are produced and shipped by our fulfillment partners. Estimated delivery windows are shown where available but are not guaranteed. Risk of loss passes to you upon carrier delivery.
terms.s6.b: Because products are printed on demand, returns are accepted only for defective, damaged, or incorrect items. Contact support.smartok.app within 30 days of delivery with your order details and photos of the issue.
terms.s7.b: You agree not to misuse the store, interfere with its operation, attempt to access other users' data, or use the service for unlawful purposes. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s8.b: The store is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, SmarTok is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the store.
